Class PresentationEyes

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.PresentationEyes
public final class PresentationEyes extends Object
One presentation's loose eye or configured eye layout and ambient expressions. Its identity and supplied clock determine expression age; physics is local and disposable. The renderer supplies gravity.
